hero-overview.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Wide cinematic photographic architectural concept image for the Sovereign Capacity Lab homepage. An Australian community workshop with a human-scale civic robot being maintained by two adult technicians, racks of modular computing in a glazed adjoining room, and a view over a coastal town with clean-energy infrastructure. Human ownership, practical capability and a welcoming public learning space. Realistic materials, warm daylight and copper details against deep green. Wide landscape image, clear composition, main visual interest toward the centre and right with calm darker negative space on the left suitable for website heading overlay. No text, logos, signs, flags or watermark. Present as a plausible future concept, not a real product photograph.

figure-repair-material.title: Retain repair and renew
figure-repair-material.alt: A stacked mass bar shows 42 kilograms retained, two kilograms supplied through reconditioning and sixteen kilograms of new modules in a sixty kilogram serviced robot.
figure-repair-material.caption: In the worked overhaul, a 60 kg robot retains 42 kg. Its 18 kg module allowance can include 2 kg of reconditioned parts and 16 kg of newly supplied material. One million such jobs therefore need 16,000 tonnes of new modules while retaining 42,000 tonnes of equipment.
figure-repair-material.creator: Sovereign Capacity Lab calculations prepared for Luke Nathan Hayes
figure-repair-material.license: Strange But True Public Source Licence
figure-repair-material.method: Matplotlib from the stated scenario inputs

figure-day-storage.title: Power during the day and stored energy overnight
figure-day-storage.alt: The upper plot shows solar output peaking near midday against a constant one gigawatt load. The lower plot shows stored energy rising during daylight and falling overnight.
figure-day-storage.caption: Illustrative repeated day: 6 GW of solar nameplate at 25 per cent capacity factor supplies a constant 1 GW load with 20 GWh of usable internal storage and 95 per cent efficiency in each direction. The plot separates instantaneous power from stored energy. Weather and seasonal adequacy need their own time series.
figure-day-storage.creator: Sovereign Capacity Lab calculations prepared for Luke Nathan Hayes
